summary: Copies driver/team identity strings and two file path strings from a source struct (a2) into this. First calls StructInitWithGlobalData, then copies a 63-byte name string from a2+17952 into this+1 (null-terminated at this[64]). Extracts the filename portion after the last backslash of the path string at a2+18196 into this+65 (31 bytes, null-terminated at this[96]). Reads a path pointer at a2+1920, falling back to the default directory global byte_5EA438 when null, extracts its filename after the last backslash into this+97 (31 bytes, null-terminated at this[128]). Finally copies a flag byte from a2+18580 into this[0]. Called from VehicleInstanceListBuilder during vehicle instance setup.

local_names.this: destination struct holding the name, two path names and a flag byte
local_names.a2: source struct with name, path and flag data
local_names.v3: pointer walked backwards over the first path string searching for the last backslash
local_names.v4: path string pointer for the second extraction, defaults to byte_5EA438 when null
local_names.v5: pointer walked backwards over the second path string searching for the last backslash

sub_587DD0(this + 1, a2 + 17952, 63) copies a 63-byte name string from the source into this, then this[64] = 0 writes the null terminator
v3 starts at the terminator of the path string at a2+18196 (a2 + 18196 + strlen)
Backslash search proceeds only while v3 is above a2+18196; when the string is empty v3 stays at the start and the search is skipped
Walk v3 backwards until a backslash (0x5C) is found, then advance one byte so it points at the filename portion after the last backslash
sub_587DD0(this + 65, v3, 31) copies the extracted first filename, then this[96] = 0 writes its null terminator
v4 = *(a2 + 1920) reads the second path pointer; when it is null it is replaced by the default directory global byte_5EA438
Second backslash search proceeds only while v5 is above v4; when the string is empty the search is skipped
Walk v5 backwards until a backslash is found, then advance one byte so it points at the filename portion after the last backslash
sub_587DD0(this + 97, v5, 31) copies the extracted second filename, then this[128] = 0 writes its null terminator
this[0] = *(a2 + 18580) copies a single flag byte from the source into the destination's first byte
Returns this, the destination struct pointer
Invoked by VehicleInstanceListBuilder during vehicle instance setup
